name: play_background_music_slot

stack.evidence: func_001E90B0 stores the top value minus one as the zero-based music slot, stops the currently active music channel through func_0011C608, starts the selected slot through func_001E9080, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001E9080 passes the selected zero-based slot to the background-music sequence start wrapper func_0011C5D8. All four JP calls pass slot 1 and occur at event transitions, including after screen fades and immediately before ordinary player control or UI state is restored.
